I will plant maize the way I know, close to what I did before. On this plot I will use one bag of urea across the season and put manure where I can, because maize gives better when I feed it a little and this land is mine. I will keep away from chemicals for weeds and insects unless I see a bad problem, and I will wait for the rains, not irrigation. I will use improved seed if I can get it from the cooperative on time, because I have seen other farmers harvest better with it.
